hook: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra halves price and cuts errors from 54 to 17 percent.
sections: It is a mid-size model for computer use.
Think of a bank clerk processing loan forms. The new clerk costs half as much, works over three times faster, and makes far fewer mistakes.
First, the model reads the task and the screen. Second, it clicks and types on the computer to finish it.
Before, errors were 53.6 percent at low effort.
Now errors are 16.7 percent, and coding tasks rose to 50.3 percent.
Routine back-office work like reading invoices becomes cheaper to automate. Our release date is an estimate. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
